subtitle: A job application tracker app your AI fills from job ads.
about: A small app inside a Pinto Notes note, with a board from Saved to Offer, what's due, and prep for each interview. Paste a job ad into your AI to add it, or move the cards yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the job hunt template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Save a job ad
slides.you: Save this one: product designer at Finch Bikes, apply by 24 November.
slides.ai: Added Finch Bikes to Saved, with the link and the deadline. It shows under Due.
slides.alt: The board: Finch Bikes in Saved, apply by Tuesday 24 November, with 8 open and 50% heard back

slides.label: Prep an interview
slides.you: Tideway's first interview is today at 14:00. Help me prep.
slides.ai: Added three questions they may ask, with your answers, and things to ask them.
slides.alt: Tideway's interview prep: three questions with answers, and questions to ask them

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and move them yourself.
slides.alt: Due: the Marlow Studio follow-up two days late, the Tideway interview today, and what's coming up
